title: Upgrading Product Onboarding
summary: Browse onboarding examples by what you are building. The redesigned ProductOnboarding.com adds clearer navigation, practical articles, and component guides to help you work through the decisions behind an onboarding flow.
body_markdown:
We've redesigned[ProductOnboarding.com](https://productonboarding.com/) to make it easier to find relevant onboarding examples. The update adds better navigation, a dedicated article section, and guides to individual components.


The site is a visual library of onboarding from other products. Use it when you're deciding how to introduce a feature, guide someone through setup, or explain what they can do next.


## What's New?


You can browse examples by brand or by the job the onboarding serves, including registration, getting started, and feature adoption. If you're working on first-time setup, you can focus on that collection instead of browsing through unrelated announcements and upgrade prompts.


The[article section](https://productonboarding.com/articles) gives us room to explain the decisions behind a flow. A screenshot can show where a tooltip appears; an article can discuss when to show it, what it should say, and whether a tour is appropriate for the task.


Component guides cover patterns such as checklists, banners, and tours. Each pairs advice with examples. The[checklist guide](https://productonboarding.com/components/checklist) , for instance, covers choosing setup tasks and tracking completion, with examples you can study alongside the guidance.


An example is a starting point for a design decision. Seeing a pattern in another product does not establish that it improved activation, or that it fits your customers. Use the library to compare approaches, then test the one that fits the task you need people to complete.


## Let us know what you think!


Browse the[redesigned site](https://productonboarding.com/) with a flow you're working on in mind. If you cannot find a useful example, tell us what you're trying to build. That helps us decide what to add next.


## What can I find on ProductOnboarding.com?


ProductOnboarding.com has a visual library of onboarding examples, articles about onboarding design, and guides to components such as checklists and tours. You can browse examples by brand or onboarding type.
